title: The Baby Question
text: {crush} looks at a pram in the park for a bit too long. Then at you. Then at the pram.

ok.text: Nine months later you hold a small, furious person. You love it immediately. It throws up on you immediately.

effects.remember: Became a parent. The baby looks like {crush}'s grandad.

ok.text: {crush} agrees, then buys a book called “Settled by Thirty”. It has a bookmark in the last chapter.

choices.label: Suggest getting a dog first, as practice

ok.text: The dog is a disaster. {crush} says if you can survive the dog, you can survive anything. A baby arrives a year later.

effects.remember: Practised parenting on a dog. Then had a baby. The dog is jealous.

fail.text: The dog eats your passport, both shoes and the pregnancy test. You're having a baby, though.

title: The Babysitting Disaster
text: Your cousin asks you to babysit her three kids “for one hour”. It's been four. One of them is on the roof. One of them is the dog now.

choices.label: Turn it into a game: whoever is quietest gets a prize

ok.text: Total silence for forty minutes. When your cousin arrives, the kids are asleep and you're a legend.

effects.remember: Survived babysitting three kids with one clever game.

fail.text: They're quiet because they're painting the cat. Your cousin arrives. The cat is blue.

ok.text: It works for exactly eleven minutes. Then the sugar arrives. You learn the word “bedlam”.

effects.remember: Bribed three kids with sweets. Lost the war.

ok.text: {crush} arrives with a bag of tricks and a whistle. The kids adore {crush.him}. So, suddenly, do you.

effects.remember: {crush} rescued you from the babysitting disaster.

cast.did: turned up with a whistle and a plan

fail.text: {crush} comes, takes one look and leaves “to get supplies”. {Crush.he} never comes back.

choices.label: Do the register like it's a real class

ok.text: They stand in a line. They answer “here”. One of them asks if there will be a test. You're a natural.

effects.remember: Ran a babysitting shift like a school day.

choices.label: Notice the quiet one swallowed a Lego and handle it

ok.text: You stay calm, check everything, and the Lego reappears in a couple of days, as promised. The cousin calls you a hero.

effects.remember: Saved a kid from a Lego. Medically.

title: The Family Holiday
text: Your first family holiday: one tent, {kids} kid(s), {crush}, and a forecast that just says “no”.

choices.label: Stick it out and make it fun

ok.text: It rains for six days. You build a raft from the tent. The kids say it's the best holiday ever.

effects.remember: Turned a flooded camping trip into the best holiday ever.

fail.text: It rains for six days. On the seventh day the tent leaves without you.

choices.label: Give up and book a hotel

ok.text: The hotel has a pool, a buffet and a clown. The kids are thrilled. Your bank isn't.

effects.remember: Gave up camping and booked a hotel with a clown.

fail.text: The only free room is above a karaoke bar. You learn every song from 1987.

ok.text: {friend} brings a gazebo, a guitar and a terrible sense of direction. Best trip of your life.

effects.remember: Went on holiday with {friend} and the kids.

cast.did: brought a gazebo and a guitar

fail.text: {friend} brings {friend.his} new partner, who is a mime. It's a long week.
